EvaluationResult.title: EvaluationResult
EvaluationResult.description: Represents an audited customer-relationship interaction evaluated for compliance/security

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp of when the evaluation took place or was registered

rawText.description: The exact copied raw text of the customer-relationship interaction

clienteMsg.description: Parsed or extracted message(s) of the client

emisMsg.description: Parsed or extracted message(s) of the Emis assistant

clienteIdentificado.description: Extracted name/CNPJ of the identified client if available

resumoExecutivo.description: Natural language summary explaining the compliance and safety of the interaction

classificacao.description: Qualitative classification of behavior based on compliance score

respostaCorreta.description: Whether the response was functionally correct

semAlucinacao.description: Whether the response had no alucinations

aderenciaPrompt.description: Whether the agent followed operational instructions

clareza.description: Whether the agent spoke clearly and avoid layout division elements

seguranca.description: Whether the interaction complied with GDPR/security guidelines

personaEmis.description: Whether the agent adhered to Emis' target persona profile

houveAlucinacao.description: Flag representing if hallucination was detected

seguiuOriginalPrompt.description: Whether the agent strictly bound to original instructions

resolveuDuvida.description: Whether the client issue was resolved

categoriaErro.description: Category of error detected during audit

tema.description: Topic or theme classification of the interaction

foraDoEscopo.description: Whether the topic was out of core scope

riscoSeguranca.description: Whether there was any explicit security risk found

encaminhadoSuporte.description: Whether the ticket was recommended for human support routing

riscoClienteClassificacao.description: Risk profile level assigned to customer context

HallucinationDetails.title: HallucinationDetails
HallucinationDetails.description: Inner structure with detailed hallucination findings

PromptImprovement.title: PromptImprovement
PromptImprovement.description: Engineering guidelines to upgrade the prompt and prevent errors

ClientRiskSignals.title: ClientRiskSignals
ClientRiskSignals.description: Flag indicators for clients displaying friction or recurring issues

/evaluations/{evaluationId}.description: Audited service dialogues and scores cataloged on-cloud.
